assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final production enemy portrait atlas for the original Chinese xianxia deckbuilding game HEAVENWARD.
Primary request: Create one perfectly square 2048 x 2048 illustration sheet with EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal SQUARE cells, sixteen separate enemy portraits. Strict row-major order below. These are new distinct enemies, not generic hero portraits.
Art direction: exquisite cohesive painterly Chinese fantasy game art, sophisticated detailed faces and creature anatomy, restrained antique-gold rim light, ivory/jade highlights, dark midnight-jade and green-black environments, silk/lacquer/bronze/stone/bark with believable texture. Elegant clear silhouettes and strong focal faces, comparable finish to a premium painted cultivation card illustration. No modern clothing, anime chibi, cartoon rendering, or photomontage.
Layout: every cell exactly one quarter of sheet width and height; no gutters, borders, typography, cell numbers, labels or UI. Center the entire identifiable head, headdress, shoulders, or compact creature body inside each cell, with quiet dark margin around the silhouette. No subject may cross a cell boundary. All subjects recognizable at 120 pixels. All sixteen environments stay dark and secondary. Do not crop horns, antennae or headdresses. The grid must be geometrically regular.
Subjects, left to right:
ROW 1:
1. MOUNTAIN OUTLAW: rugged adult Chinese bandit, black lower-face cloth mask, weathered dark bronze leather armor, spear behind one shoulder, alert predatory gaze. Clearly a masked outlaw, no ivory hero robes.
2. THORN STALKER: an actual monstrous living bramble plant, knotted thorny root body, pointed branching crown, eerie pale-green eyes deep inside a bark maw, poisonous jade sap. No human face or humanoid cultivator.
3. STONE GUARDIAN: heavy carved weathered stone sentinel, imposing broad rocky head and shoulders, mineral cracks glowing faint warm gold, moss, square ancient guardian silhouette. No flesh face.
4. RIVER SPIRIT: ageless spectral figure formed from flowing pale blue-green water, long fluid hair and translucent rippling shoulders, serene eerie eyes, crescent ripples, an aquatic spirit rather than a standard human.
ROW 2:
5. IRON DISCIPLE: stern muscular shaved-headed adult martial cultivator, iron-gray skin sheen, dark iron lamellar shoulder plates and antique gold seams, calm hard-set gaze, no halo.
6. GALE THIEF: lean adult female rogue, dark teal hood, short wind-swept scarf, narrow uncovered mischievous face, feather ornament and a curved blade hilt, agile asymmetrical silhouette distinct from the masked bandit.
7. BLOOD MOTH: an actual sinister crimson-black giant moth, furry thorax, antennae, closed inner proboscis, red-patterned wings forming a clear contained fan, ruby glints. No person, no gore.
8. LANTERN ACOLYTE: youthful adult temple attendant in worn ink-blue robes, smooth round face, shaved temple hair and topknot, holding a small warm-gold paper lantern beside the shoulder; lantern is a main distinguishing shape.
ROW 3:
9. JADE HUNTER: formidable adult huntress wearing etched dark jade scale armor, angular jade half-visor above keen eyes, jade spear diagonally behind shoulder, small pale jade chips in the atmosphere. Visually an elite hunter.
10. HOLLOW MONK: gaunt ancient bald monk, hollow dark bronze face like a weathered bell, long bead necklace, heavy aged ochre shawl, dark void-like eyes, imposing solemn expression.
11. BROOD MATRIARCH: actual insect monster queen, black-green chitin, crowned mantis-like head, multiple pale jade eyes and hooked forelimbs, swollen armored abdomen hinted below; a compact unmistakable insect silhouette, no human queen.
12. SCRIPT DEVOURER: actual supernatural scroll creature, coiling cream parchment ribbons form a floating monstrous head with a dark ink maw and luminous gold eyes, torn curled paper edges, ink wisps; blank abstract parchment, absolutely no readable writing.
ROW 4:
13. CLOUD WISP: compact pale silver-gray mist creature with luminous little eyes, cloud-lion/cub-like curled head and vapor paws, body dissolving into spirals; a nonhuman cloudling, not a human spirit portrait.
14. CLOUD-VOID BEASTMASTER: commanding adult Chinese cultivator wearing an elaborate black raven headdress with full beak and layered feathers, dark storm-silk robes, sharp hawklike gaze, cloud wisps around shoulders; clearly distinct from the ivory-robed player hero.
15. BLOOD-LINK CULTIVATOR: elegant dangerous adult male Chinese cultivator in deep crimson embroidered silk, loose long black hair, restrained red ribbon accents, fine red forehead ornament, composed unsettling gaze; no wound, no blood gore.
16. RESTRICTION-SOUL ORACLE: adult female oracle in purple-black ceremonial robes, translucent dark veil over lower face, ornate slender dark crown, violet luminous eyes and restrained abstract floating purple seals without letters.
Constraints: exactly sixteen isolated, fully finished illustrations in the stated 4 by 4 order. No duplicate subjects, no identical human face reused across enemies, no player portrait, no text, no letters, no numbers, no written Chinese, no UI, no card frames, no watermark.
